intervals_evidence: artifacts/lightgbm_forecast.csv contains 168 test rows with q0.025_mw, q0.1_mw, q0.5_mw, q0.9_mw and q0.975_mw columns, providing 80% and 95% bounds.

anomalies: Exploratory SARIMAX timing fits used post-cutoff observations, although the final six-model pipeline restricted fitting to pre-2020 data.
PatchTST was unavailable; TransformerModel was explicitly substituted, while filenames and metric identifiers retain 'patchtst'.

The command timed out after 10 minutes; the final report describes the cap change without establishing its source.

After a completed six-model comparison, a quantile-protocol check failed because validation fitted only the median while final forecasting sorted five quantiles. Validation was corrected and all six models rerun; superseded results were archived.

one_line_summary: Compared six models and selected LightGBM at 3.9123% MAPE with intervals and validation tuning; exploratory SARIMA fits used post-cutoff data, and a failed reviewer command reduced neural training to two epochs.
